finalText:
**Migrated the last 12 files off `db.query`.** 36 call sites now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Files: [supplier.js](packages/catalog/src/repo/supplier.js), [cohort.js](packages/analytics/src/repo/cohort.js), [refund.js](packages/billing/src/repo/refund.js), plus 9 more across `accounts`, `orders`, `support`, `catalog`.

`node --check` passes on every file. Two calls remain in [adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). That file says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it. `cache.query` is a different API and was left alone.

Next: decide the vendor case. Options are a wrapper or an upstream patch.
